scope: Portal V2 lesson-video additions and replacements, including lesson-description updates and stream-specific prepared lesson projections
ownerGoal: A future video change must be executed through the full live data path in one controlled pass, rather than repeatedly patching canonical KV, prepared state and catalogue/access state after browser failures.

precedence.rule: For lesson-video changes, this playbook is the current general execution authority. More specific lesson-scope overrides, including GCH_OVERRIDE_2026-09-30_L3T2M24_L3_ONLY.json, take precedence within their declared lesson scope.
doesNotSupersede: Replace Resource semantics for PDFs/worksheets/Answer Packs
existing student-access/business rules except when a lesson's stream/catalogue classification itself is explicitly changed by the owner

criticalArchitectureFact.statement: The browser can consume the current prepared lesson read model rather than the canonical LESSONS_KV record directly. Therefore a successful canonical video write does not prove that the live browser will serve the new video.
criticalArchitectureFact.requiredConsequence: Every video update must verify and, when necessary, republish the current prepared lesson scope in the same operation. Do not stop at lesson:<canonicalLessonId> readback.

required: owner-supplied display lesson code or unambiguous lesson identity
owner-supplied full ScreenPal content URL pasted as text
stream classification when not already unambiguous from current authority: normal, 11plus-only, or genuinely shared
inputContract.screenPalIdRule: Extract the ID from the exact pasted URL and preserve character case exactly. Do not rely on screenshot OCR or visual inference for ambiguous I/l/1/O/0 characters.
inputContract.descriptionRule: If a script/source is supplied, derive the lesson description from that source only. Do not silently invent lesson content not supported by the supplied script.

mandatoryPreflight: Read AGENTS.md, GCH_CURRENT.json and this playbook before any video mutation.
Read any scope-specific override for the lesson before mutation.
Prove current main and production Worker/bindings; production recovery remains forward-only.
Resolve the canonical lessonId from current canonical/prepared catalogue evidence. Do not infer stream eligibility from an internal canonical ID such as Y6M1.4.
Read canonical lesson:<id>, current prepared global scope, and current prepared lesson:<id> scope.
Determine exact live catalogue memberships and display IDs before mutation.
Determine whether this is a pure video/description change or also a stream/catalogue classification change.
Capture the old ScreenPal ID(s) so final verification can prove they are absent from the active prepared target when replacement is intended.

A_sameClassification_videoOnlyOrVideoPlu.examples: Normal Year lesson replacement, L1/L2/L3 lesson replacement where catalogue membership is not changing.
mutate: canonical lesson video fields used by current schema, including video and core.video when both exist
contentStatus fields for mainVideo/description as appropriate
current prepared lesson scope/video variant used by the existing stream classification
A_sameClassification_videoOnlyOrVideoPlu.completion: Canonical and prepared lesson readbacks both point to the exact new ScreenPal ID; obsolete replacement ID is absent from the active prepared variant; description readback matches the approved source-derived text.

B_firstVideoAddition_sameClassification.completion: The current prepared lesson contains the expected targetUrl/embed and the public/browser lesson renders the new video.

C_streamOrCatalogueClassificationChange.trigger: Owner says the lesson must move between streams, become 11plus-only, become normal-only, or stop being genuinely shared.
mutate: curriculum membership if required by current canonical model
only the student access snapshots actually affected by the removed/added catalogue source
prepared lesson videoVariants so only legitimate stream variants remain
requiredVerification: forbidden catalogue/display alias absent from canonical and prepared global state
affected access snapshots rebuilt from current canonical state only
prepared lesson has only legitimate stream video variants
new ScreenPal ID present and obsolete replacement ID absent

streamVariantRules.normalOnly: Prepared lesson must not acquire an elevenPlus variant merely because the canonical ID is shared with historical/other material.
streamVariantRules.elevenPlusOnly: Prepared lesson must not retain/create a normal variant. Catalogue membership must not be inferred from Year-like canonical IDs.
streamVariantRules.genuinelyShared: Update each legitimate prepared video variant deliberately; verify all intended variants and no extras.
streamVariantRules.specialLessonOverride: If a scope-specific GCH says a lesson is L3/11+-only, that rule overrides generic Year 6/L3 equivalence for that lesson.

atomicCompletionChecklist: Exact ScreenPal ID parsed from pasted URL and echoed in prewrite guard.
Canonical lesson identity/title/subject/display mapping guarded before write.
Current prepared lesson scope republished or explicitly proven already equivalent to the new canonical target.
Prepared lesson read back from current pointer, not merely from a newly written version key.
Correct stream video variant targetUrl contains the exact new ScreenPal ID.
Old ScreenPal ID is absent from the active prepared variant when this is a replacement.
If description changed, canonical and prepared/public description are consistent where projected.
If classification changed, prepared global catalogue and lessonToViews are updated and verified.
If classification changed, only affected student access scopes are refreshed and verified.
Public/API/browser path is smoke-checked when authenticated access is available; otherwise state explicitly that browser render remains owner-verification pending.
No rollback/revert/older Worker deployment is used.

knownFailureModesAndEvidence.failure: ScreenPal ID was transcribed with uppercase I instead of lowercase l.
knownFailureModesAndEvidence.lesson: Never infer an ambiguous ScreenPal character from a screenshot when the owner can paste the exact URL; IDs are case-sensitive.

knownFailureModesAndEvidence.failure: Canonical lesson video had already been changed to cOQvDXnxxvX, but the current prepared lesson still contained old ScreenPal cOVTQxn3IMa, so the live browser continued serving the old recording.
knownFailureModesAndEvidence.lesson: Canonical KV-only video updates are incomplete. The current prepared lesson projection must be updated/read back in the same operation.

knownFailureModesAndEvidence.failure: The canonical record still exposed a normal Year 6 alias Y6T2M8 and prepared global state materialised the lesson into both maths-year6 and maths-level3 even though the owner classified it as L3/11+-only.
knownFailureModesAndEvidence.lesson: When stream classification changes, the fix is not a video-only write: remove forbidden canonical/global mappings, refresh affected access snapshots, and publish the correct stream-only prepared lesson variant.

l3t2m24IncidentReference.browserFollowUp: After the backend/prepared repair, the owner still reported seeing a 'Lessons' card on the Maths landing page. Treat that as a separate navigation/presentation investigation; do not use it as evidence that the prepared video replacement itself reverted.

futureOperatorRule: For ordinary same-classification video work, use .github/workflows/ops-replace-lesson-video-generic.yml by updating .github/ops-replace-lesson-video-request.json. Use intent=replacement when an existing video is present and intent=addition when canonical/prepared state has no video. Supply descriptionPolicy=source-derived plus newDescription only when the owner supplied a script/source. The workflow must resolve lesson -> guard canonical/prepared identity -> update/add canonical video -> republish current prepared lesson -> verify exact target and old-ID absence where applicable -> publish/verify description if authorised -> prove lessonToViews/catalogue classification unchanged. Escalate to case C only when owner intent actually changes stream/catalogue membership.

completionLanguage.allowedWhenAllBackendChecksPass: Canonical and current prepared lesson state both verified against the exact ScreenPal ID.
completionLanguage.browserCaveat: If no authenticated browser smoke-check was executed, say browser rendering is not yet independently confirmed.
completionLanguage.prohibited: Do not say a video is live merely because LESSONS_KV changed or a GitHub workflow succeeded without prepared readback.

genericExecutionWorkflow.purpose: Execute ordinary same-classification lesson-video replacements or first additions through one guarded path that updates and read-backs canonical LESSONS_KV and the current prepared lesson scope, with optional source-derived description publication.

requestContract.descriptionPolicy: unchanged-no-source-supplied unless a separately supported description update is authorised

safety: Refuses classificationChange=true; stream/catalogue changes still require the case-C path.
For replacement, requires exactly one canonical and one prepared ScreenPal ID before mutation.
For first addition, requires no existing canonical/prepared ScreenPal ID and no prepared videoVariants before mutation.
First additions create canonical core.video using the standard ScreenPal shape and prepared videoVariants using the production compiler shape, with resourceCount incremented by one.
Freezes and verifies lessonToViews so a video-only or video+description change cannot silently alter stream/catalogue membership.
Replaces or adds the exact owner-pasted case-sensitive ScreenPal ID and verifies current prepared state after publication.
When a source-derived description is supplied, verifies canonical, prepared lesson and prepared global catalogue-row description parity.

descriptionPolicies.source-derived: Publish the supplied source-derived description to canonical lesson, prepared lesson detail and the matching prepared global catalogue row without changing catalogue membership.
